title: Battle Top-Left OAM AP-Cost HUD
description: Selected-card AP-cost pips (OAM sprites, not BG tiles): one icon per energy cost, shown top-left of each hand card (cost 0 shows none). Cells are enemy_sprites sheet names (compose_enemy_sprites.py TILE_COORDS); values are slotted OBJ ramps (palette.txt) used both to encode the tile bytes and to program the battle OBJ slot the icon renders with (ap_tiles_generated.h). The three-ap art stays staged in the sheet until a 3-cost card exists (no free OAM tile below the BG-art aliasing today).
